resume.headline: Software Engineer
resume.summary: Software Engineer with 4+ years of experience shipping production applications and data services, from PostgreSQL schemas and authentication to JavaScript and React interfaces deployed on Vercel. Built and operates a live inventory application that replaced 7 paper and spreadsheet logs for a small business. Holds an M.S. in Applied Computer Science and AWS Cloud Practitioner and Azure certifications.

bullets.label: Full-Stack Delivery
bullets.text: Builds and operates a production inventory web app with a JavaScript frontend, a supabase-js data layer, and a Supabase PostgreSQL backend, deployed on Vercel and used daily.

bullets.label: Schema Design
bullets.text: Designs PostgreSQL tables with status enums, update triggers, and indexed lookups plus an append-only history table, replacing 7 paper and spreadsheet logs.

bullets.label: Access Control
bullets.text: Secures the application with Supabase Auth email sign-in and row-level security policies on every table, restricting data access to authenticated sessions.

bullets.label: Dashboard Interface
bullets.text: Implements login, dashboard, and migration pages with stat cards, a reorder schedule, per-item history views, and SheetJS Excel export for purchasing workflows.

bullets.label: Data Migration
bullets.text: Migrates 8 legacy CSV exports into normalized history rows, parsing free-text thresholds into numeric par levels and routing unparseable values to a review queue.

bullets.label: Web Application
bullets.text: Built CodeRepoReader AI as a Flask web app with REST endpoints for repository upload or GitHub URL input and conversational Q&A over the analyzed codebase.

bullets.label: Static Analyzer
bullets.text: Engineered a static analyzer for 4 languages using Python AST and regex, extracting classes, functions, dependencies, and entry points into structured context.

bullets.label: Serverless Deployment
bullets.text: Ported the service to the OpenAI SDK and deployed it on Vercel serverless functions with a per-session cache that avoids rescanning repositories on follow-up questions.

bullets.label: Data Services
bullets.text: Developed Python and SQL services that consolidated 40+ regional SQL Server sources into shared Snowflake datasets, standardizing business keys across roughly 5 million records.

bullets.label: Release Engineering
bullets.text: Shipped code through Git and Azure DevOps with peer code reviews and automated checks, keeping pipeline code and configuration changes traceable across releases.

bullets.label: Automated Validation
bullets.text: Automated source-to-target reconciliation checks that caught data defects before release, reducing recurring reporting errors by more than 90% for downstream users.

bullets.label: Production Support
bullets.text: Monitored production jobs with Amazon CloudWatch alerts and retries, tracing root causes in schema changes and source outages, then validated fixes before resuming operation.

bullets.label: Row-Level Security
bullets.text: Implemented row-level security and scheduled refresh in Power BI so regional stakeholders saw only their own data on dependable, current dashboards.

bullets.label: Full-Stack Architecture
bullets.text: Architected a React and Vite frontend over Vercel serverless REST endpoints in Node.js, orchestrating a 4-stage OpenAI pipeline with JSON Schema structured outputs.

bullets.label: Automated Testing
bullets.text: Covered lint rules, schema validity, and DOCX export with unit tests on the Node.js test runner, alongside an evaluation harness over 20 labeled job descriptions.

bullets.label: Document Export
bullets.text: Generated one-page DOCX and print-ready PDF resumes in the browser, auto-fitting font size so every tailored resume renders on a single Letter page.

bullets.label: On-Device Inference
bullets.text: Built an Android app that runs TensorFlow Lite models on device with OpenCV, keeping triage inference available without a network connection.

bullets.label: Image Preprocessing
bullets.text: Integrated OpenCV image preprocessing ahead of TensorFlow Lite inference so camera input reached the model in the format it expected.

emails.subject: Junior Full-Stack Engineer | production React, Postgres, auth
emails.body:
Hi Hiring Team,
Greetings of the day.

I am Vamshi Krishna, a Software Engineer with over four years of experience shipping production applications and data services. I hold a master's degree in Applied Computer Science and am interested in the Junior Full-Stack Engineer position at Mosaic Health Apps.

At LAMA Desserts, I built and operate a live inventory application with a JavaScript frontend, Supabase Auth, and a PostgreSQL schema secured with row-level security, deployed on Vercel. I also built ApplyForge, a React and Node.js application with serverless APIs and unit tests. At DXC Technology, I shipped production code through Git and Azure DevOps reviews and supported it in operation. This experience aligns with your focus on shipping secure full-stack features from schema to deployment.

I have attached my resume for your consideration. I would welcome the opportunity to learn more about this role and your team, and I look forward to hearing from you regarding the next steps in the hiring process.

Best regards,
Vamshi Krishna Balupari
+1 (660) 493-5399 | vamshikrishnabalupari@gmail.com
